children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' walking game where children practice the one-two-three rhythm.

seniors.counts: Maintain the 3/4 count but at a slower tempo.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the walking steps with feet while seated, focusing on the weight shift of the balance.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the walking steps with support from a partner or barre, omitting the rise on toes if balance is a concern.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to a comfortable walking pace; limit range of motion for pivots.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Closed position; hands held throughout, even during crossing figures.
movement_profile.footwork: Walking steps, balancing, skipping, and pivoting.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Closed ballroom position or side-by-side; moves in a line or rotation.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Rising on toes; no jumps described.
movement_profile.partnering: Man leads with left foot, lady follows with right.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, rising on toes with each step.

signature_moves.description: Throwing weight successively onto one foot and then the other.
signature_moves.name: Balance

signature_moves.description: Making every other step a skipping step.
signature_moves.name: Skipping

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not bring the trailing foot forward when balancing forward, and do not bring the forward foot backward when balancing backward.

music_profile.sound_description: The music follows the standard waltz time, characterized by a consistent one, two, three pulse that supports walking and balancing steps.

basic_steps: Step forward (man) or backward (lady) on the count of one, two, three.
Rise on toes with each step.
Balance by shifting weight between feet without bringing the trailing foot forward or backward.
Pivot on the man's right foot (lady's left) to perform turns.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly due to the walking nature, but requires practice for graceful balancing.
